answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent’s signing identity to a key released only after remote attestation verifies its enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and platform. A copied VM cannot forge the hardware-backed quote or extract the sealed key; creating additional identities therefore requires additional trusted enclave capacity—ultimately physical silicon, not mere virtual duplication. Fresh challenges prevent replay, while oasis, lotus, and crystal may label agents but confer no trust.
